name: dev-practices
description: Practices for building agent skills and keeping a codebase honest. deterministic-sandwich moves every deterministic step of a skill into a script so the LLM makes exactly one natural-language judgment. comment-diet is a setup wizard that bans code comments in a repo: it installs a comment lint with a baseline that only shrinks, a pull-request check and a repo-local delete-comment skill that moves decisions into tests or records and files issues for excuses.
